analysis: The only change in this PR is documentation: one new row in docs/reference/configuration.md at head line 397, for `DARKBLOOM_TTFT_FUSED_CAUSAL_PREFILL`. The row says the variable is read once per process, is not forwarded to LaunchAgents, and defaults on. It describes a numerical and scheduling optimization, using one `.causal` SDPA call instead of 128-query blocks for eligible full-attention prefill chunks. No code in the supplied evidence changes. The documented behavior does not alter authorization, attestation, encryption, key handling, the coordinator-to-provider wire protocol, the prefix-cache at-rest format, or cache scoping (T-041, TB-007). The fused path could in principle change timing and therefore the TTFT oracle in T-041, but SEC-035 already accepts that channel, and the doc gives no evidence that the cache lookup, scope or HMAC logic changed. The variable is a local env override, which sits under the existing operator-controlled environment assumption (TB-003). The exclusion of live packed paged KV is a correctness statement and not a security control. Untested items: the actual implementation in AttentionV1.swift is not in the supplied evidence, so I cannot confirm that the fused kernel keeps causal-mask isolation between requests in batched prefill. This is a qualification question and not a finding, because no code diff is present. No threat-model updates seem needed from this documentation row.
